fields.role: The job title or function of the person associated with the record.
fields.operational_phase: The current stage of plant operation.
fields.access_level: The degree of physical or system access permitted.
fields.high_pressure_reverse_osmosis_skids: Narrative operational rules or constraints for HP RO skids.
fields.parameter: The name of the operational variable being monitored.
fields.subject: The specific equipment or stream being measured.
fields.parameter_tag: The unique identifier tag for the instrument or parameter.
fields.measurement: The type of measurement being taken.
fields.metric_unit: The unit of measure for the value.
fields.min_bound: The lower limit of an acceptable range.
fields.max_bound: The upper limit of an acceptable range.
fields.required_correction: The action to be taken to bring a parameter back into range.
fields.time_allowance: The duration permitted for a condition to persist or a task to be completed.
fields.action: The result or required response triggered by a specific event.
fields.low_tier_alert: The threshold for a low-level warning.
fields.critical_low_trip: The threshold for a critical low-level system shutdown.
fields.high_tier_alert: The threshold for a high-level warning.
fields.critical_high_trip: The threshold for a critical high-level system shutdown.
fields.regulatory_compliance: Mandates based on legal or regulatory standards.
fields.trigger: The event or condition that initiates a response.

categories.AccessConstraint: Constraints regarding who can access equipment or areas.
categories.TriggeredResponse: Actions taken in response to a specific trigger.
categories.TriggeredAlert: Notifications generated by a specific trigger.
categories.TriggeredTrip: Automatic shutdowns generated by a specific trigger.
categories.SequencingRequirement: Requirements regarding the order of operations.
categories.DataRetentionRequirement: Rules for how long data must be stored.
categories.DiagnosticProcedure: Steps for troubleshooting or analyzing equipment.
